title: U.S. House, District 24
what_it_does: Represents Florida's 24th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives; votes on federal laws and spending.
verified_ballot_note: Open seat (Rep. Frederica Wilson retiring). Roster from WLRN, CBS Miami, Local 10, NBC6 and Florida Politics: Oliver Gilbert (D) vs. Te Mayonna Brown (R), who was unopposed in her primary. County makeup: Miami-Dade-based district; local coverage (Miramar News) describes it as also reaching into Broward. Sources: https://www.wlrn.org/government-politics/2026-08-18/oliver-gilbert-prevails-in-crowded-7-way-democratic-primary-to-succeed-rep-frederica-wilson ; https://www.nbcmiami.com/news/politics/decision/te-brown-is-projected-winner-of-floridas-district-24-republican-primary/3847775/ ; https://www.miramarflnews.com/news/local/article316923349.html Florida adopted a new congressional map (passed Apr 29, 2026, signed May 4, 2026) that reworked 21 of 28 districts; county descriptions here reflect post-redistricting reporting where found (https://www.wusf.org/politics-issues/2026-05-06/breakdown-changes-for-florida-new-congressional-map).

candidates.name: Oliver Gilbert
candidates.occupation: Former Miami-Dade County Commissioner; former Mayor of Miami Gardens
candidates.background: Oliver Gilbert is a former Miami-Dade County Commissioner and former mayor of Miami Gardens. He won the seven-way Aug. 18, 2026 Democratic primary with about 34.5%, edging state Sen. Shevrin Jones (about 32%), with Kendrick Meek Jr. (about 17%), Rudolph Moise, Jean Monestime, Marshall Davis Sr. and Roderick Vereen trailing.
candidates.primary_result: Won Aug 18, 2026 Democratic primary with ~34.5% over Shevrin Jones (~32%), Kendrick Meek Jr. (~17%) and four others (Florida Politics; Local 10; CBS Miami)
